# Lag aggregation from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/lagdata.c (add_ping, QueryPLoss).
# ping <sequence of samples, ms> <current> <avg> <min> <max>
#   Each sample is clamped to 0..10000 FIRST, then: avg = (avg * 7 + ping) / 8 with
#   integer truncation, so the average decays toward a new level and never exceeds it
#   from below. ASSS starts a fresh player at avg 0, min INT_MAX, max 0, which is what
#   these sequences assume; min/max compare the CLAMPED value.
# ploss <packets sent> <packets received> <loss as printed with %.6f>
#   0.0 unless sent > 200 (PLOSS_MIN_PACKETS); otherwise (sent - received) / sent in
#   double precision. Both are unsigned, so received > sent wraps to a huge positive
#   loss -- ASSS does not guard against it.
